input.command:
python3 -c "
import json

with open('/root/tutorial_index.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

print('1. Valid JSON: PASS')

chapters = data['chapters']
print(f'2. Chapter count: {len(chapters)} (expected 29) -> {\"PASS\" if len(chapters) == 29 else \"FAIL\"}\n')

expected_titles = [
    'What we\'ll do', 'How we\'ll get there', 'Getting a floor plan', 'Getting started',
    'Basic Navigation', 'Import your plan into Blender', 'Basic transform operations',
    'Setting up the plan and units', 'It all starts with a plane',
    'Scaling the plane to real dimensions', 'Getting the plan in place', 'Tracing the outline',
    'Tracing inner walls', 'Break', 'Continue tracing inner walls', 'Remove doubled vertices',
    'Save', 'Make the floor', 'Remove unnecessary geometry', 'Make the floor\'s faces',
    'Make the background', 'Extruding the walls in Z', 'Reviewing face orientation',
    'Adding thickness to walls with Modifiers', 'Fixing face orientation errors',
    'Note on face orientation', 'Save As', 'If you need thick and thin walls', 'Great job!'
]

actual_titles = [c['title'] for c in chapters]
print('3. Title matching:')
all_match = True
for i, (exp, act) in enumerate(zip(expected_titles, actual_titles)):
    if exp != act:
        print(f'   MISMATCH at index {i}: expected \"{exp}\", got \"{act}\"')
        all_match = False
if len(expected_titles) != len(actual_titles):
    print(f'   Length mismatch: expected {len(expected_titles)}, got {len(actual_titles)}')
    all_match = False
print(f'   -> {\"PASS\" if all_match else \"FAIL\"}\n')

print(f'4. First chapter time: {chapters[0][\"time\"]} (expected 0) -> {\"PASS\" if chapters[0][\"time\"] == 0 else \"FAIL\"}\n')

times = [c['time'] for c in chapters]
monotonic = all(times[i] < times[i+1] for i in range(len(times)-1))
print(f'5. Monotonically increasing: -> {\"PASS\" if monotonic else \"FAIL\"}')
if not monotonic:
    for i in range(len(times)-1):
        if times[i] >= times[i+1]:
            print(f'   Issue at index {i}: {times[i]} >= {times[i+1]} (chapter \"{chapters[i][\"title\"]}\" -> \"{chapters[i+1][\"title\"]}\")')

in_range = all(0 <= t <= 1382 for t in times)
print(f'6. All timestamps in [0, 1382]: -> {\"PASS\" if in_range else \"FAIL\"}')
if not in_range:
    for i, t in enumerate(times):
        if t < 0 or t > 1382:
            print(f'   Out of range at index {i}: {t} (chapter \"{chapters[i][\"title\"]}\")')

print()
print('--- Summary ---')
all_pass = all([len(chapters) == 29, all_match, chapters[0]['time'] == 0, monotonic, in_range])
print(f'Overall: {\"ALL CHECKS PASSED\" if all_pass else \"SOME CHECKS FAILED\"}')
"
